places.name: Alleppey Houseboat Cruise (Alappuzha)
places.description: An overnight houseboat on the Alleppey backwaters is the single most iconic and romantic experience in all of Kerala.
places.bestTime: October to February for pleasant weather

places.name: Vembanad Lake
places.description: The vast open water of Vembanad at sunset, with fishing canoes and distant palms, is the quintessential Kerala landscape.
places.bestTime: October to February; August for boat race

places.name: Nehru Trophy Boat Race, Alleppey
places.description: 100 oarsmen powering a 120-foot snake boat in unison across a Kerala lake is one of the most thrilling spectacles in India.
places.mapsSearch: Nehru Trophy Boat Race Alleppey Punnamada Lake

places.name: Kumarakom Bird Sanctuary
places.description: A dawn canoe through Kumarakom, with migratory birds in every tree and the lake mist lifting, is magical.
places.bestTime: Early morning, October to February for migrants

places.name: Kollam Backwaters and Ashtamudi Lake
places.description: The 8-hour Kollam–Alleppey canoe journey through narrow canals shows a Kerala almost untouched by tourism.

places.name: Alleppey Beach
places.description: The old pier at sunset, with fishing boats coming in from the Arabian Sea, is one of Kerala's most atmospheric beach scenes.

places.name: Chinese Fishing Nets, Fort Kochi
places.description: The Chinese fishing nets at sunset are Kerala's most iconic image — and watching them in operation is genuinely fascinating.
places.mapsSearch: Chinese fishing nets Fort Kochi Kerala

places.name: Fort Kochi Heritage District
places.description: Fort Kochi's layered colonial heritage and multicultural street life make it one of India's most fascinating urban neighbourhoods.

places.name: Kuttanad ('The Rice Bowl of Kerala')
places.description: Farming below sea level in a boat-accessed village world — Kuttanad is one of geography's most extraordinary landscapes.
places.mapsSearch: Kuttanad below sea level farming Kerala backwaters
places.bestTime: November to December for rice harvest

places.name: Krishnapuram Palace Museum, Kayamkulam
places.description: The giant Gajendra Moksham mural alone makes this journey worthwhile — one of the most powerful Kerala murals surviving.
